openai/gpt-oss-120b.markdown:
# Godot 4 忍者平台游戏学习图谱

## 总览  
[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 00:09]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 01:46]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 02:04]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 02:48]  
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    SeriesGoal["制作忍者平台游戏"] --> Inspiration["参考忍者龙剑传"]
    SeriesGoal --> Features["爬墙、剑攻击、跳跃攻击"]
    Features --> AnimationSplit["上半身/下半身动画分离"]
    SeriesGoal --> Engine["Godot 4.4（免费开源）"]
    SeriesGoal --> TargetAudience["适合有编程基础且不熟悉Godot的用户"]
    SeriesGoal --> Outcome["后续可添加敌人射弹等功能"]
```

## 项目创建流程  
[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 03:23]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 03:58]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 04:12]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 04:21]  
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    OpenEngine["打开Godot"] --> NewProject["创建新项目"]
    NewProject --> NameProject["命名为'ninja platformer'"]
    NameProject --> KeepDefaults["保持默认设置"]
    KeepDefaults --> Create2DScene["创建2D场景"]
    Create2DScene --> SetMainScene["设为主场景"]
    SetMainScene --> RunGame["运行游戏测试"]
    RunGame --> Confirm["确认项目创建成功"]
```

## 像素艺术设置流程  
[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 06:22]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 06:28]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 06:59]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 07:42]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 07:57]  
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    OpenProjectSettings["打开项目设置"] --> SetViewport["视口宽320×180，高180"]
    SetViewport --> SetWindowSize["窗口大小1280×720"]
    SetWindowSize --> SetStretchMode["拉伸模式: 2D"]
    SetStretchMode --> SetTextureFilter["纹理过滤: 最近邻"]
    SetTextureFilter --> RunGameCheck["运行游戏检查像素显示"]
    RunGameCheck --> Result["清晰像素艺术显示"]
```

## 资产导入与测试流程  
[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 05:27]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 06:01]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 06:10]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 07:57]、[BV1wdNx6bEg6 P1 08:08]  
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    DownloadAssets["从GitHub下载资源ZIP"] --> ExtractAssets["解压获取SP文件夹"]
    ExtractAssets --> DragAssets["拖入项目文件系统"]
    DragAssets --> AddDrone["添加无人机占位物"]
    AddDrone --> RunGameShow["运行游戏查看无人机"]
    RunGameShow --> RemoveDrone["删除无人机占位物"]
    RemoveDrone --> ReadyForEnemy["准备添加敌人"]
    ReadyForEnemy --> NextVideo["进入下一视频创建角色"]
```
